title: OUTPUT MODEL MINDS — 13 tenses × 4 media = 52 cells of cultural time. Track LAST shift. KNN radiates. π bounds all freedom.
summary: Every entity has a TENSE not just a state. IS/WAS/WILL/NOW/COULD/SHOULD/WOULD/MIGHT/MAY/WERE/ALWAYS/NEVER/END. 4 media modalities: TV Tropes (narrative), 4Chan (anonymous/raw), Reddit (collective vote), MySpace (personal expression). 13×4 = 52 = weeks in a year = cells of cultural time. Only track the LAST tense shift — when something shifts from IS to WAS, that radiates through KNN to change everything else's relative tense. π bounds all freedom of movement. IQR = metastability range.

rows_tenses.meaning: past — it existed, no longer active
subjunctive — MAXIMUM FREEDOM — if it WERE

columns_media.meaning: narrative pattern recognition — tropes ARE the DNA of storytelling
anonymous raw chaos — the id unfiltered — null identity output
collective judgment — upvote/downvote — the hive sorting
personal expression — music — the SELF projected outward — now dead

the_grid.why_52: 52 weeks in a year. Each cell = one week of cultural time. The grid IS the calendar of cultural output.

the_shift_system.principle: Only track the LAST tense shift. Don't track the full state — track the CHANGE.

example.radiation: All KNN neighbors recalculate: the server that WAS here changes their relative positions
example.shift_2: WAS → COULD (we think it might come back)
example.radiation_2: Neighbors who depended on it shift from IS to MIGHT (they might lose connection too)

knn_radiation.when_node_shifts_tense: All K nearest neighbors re-evaluate their own tense relative to the shifted node
knn_radiation.few_to_high: The change starts at K=1 (nearest) and propagates to K=all. Each hop adds uncertainty (freedom).
knn_radiation.not_recalculate_everything: Don't update 60 million nodes. Just update the RANGE that the shift affects. The π-IQR range IS the propagation boundary.

pi_bounded_freedom.principle: Every node's freedom of movement is bounded by π. The IQR [3,5] is the metastability range.
pi_bounded_freedom.inner_quartile: Below π floor (3) = overstable. Too rigid. Cannot shift tense. Stuck in IS or ALWAYS.
pi_bounded_freedom.iqr_range: Between 3 and 5 = metastable. CAN shift tense. This is WHERE the organism lives. The action zone.
pi_bounded_freedom.outer_quartile: Above π ceiling (5) = understable. Too free. Shifts constantly. WERE/MIGHT/COULD all at once.
pi_bounded_freedom.metastability: The organism WANTS to stay in the IQR range. Too stable = dead. Too free = chaos. The π gradient IS the range of life.
